description: This file contains unit tests for the PooledQueueCache component of the Orleans streaming runtime. It includes test classes, cache setup, and tests for cache behavior such as golden path, cache purging, cache miss handling, and multiple stream handling.

classes.name: PooledQueueCacheTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the PooledQueueCache, including scenarios for cache operations and edge cases.

classes.name: TestQueueMessage
classes.description: Represents a test message with stream ID, sequence number, data payload, and enqueue time.

classes.name: TestBatchContainer
classes.description: A test implementation of IBatchContainer with serializer attributes.

classes.name: TestCacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements ICacheDataAdapter to deserialize CachedMessages into IBatchContainer instances.

classes.name: CachedMessageConverter
classes.description: Converts TestQueueMessage instances into CachedMessage objects, handling serialization into pooled buffers.

methods.name: GoldenPathTest
methods.description: Tests an ideal cache flow with multiple streams to verify correct message retrieval.

methods.name: CacheDrainTest
methods.description: Tests cache behavior after purging, ensuring it correctly handles repeated golden path runs.

methods.name: AvoidCacheMiss
methods.description: Tests cache behavior with missing messages scenarios, both with and without empty cache.

methods.name: SimpleCacheMiss
methods.description: Verifies that the cache throws on miss when messages are missing or have been purged.

methods.name: RunGoldenPath
methods.description: Simulates writing a batch of messages into the cache and reading them back with cursors to verify correctness.
